name: Rising water level
note: Synthetic demonstration scenario. Not a reconstruction of any real flood event and not validated against observations. The level series is arbitrary, not an observed hydrograph. Show that sentence on screen.

perturbations.flooded_rule: cell is flooded where DEM <= water_level_m
perturbations.road_rule: segment flooded when the mean DEM at its endpoints <= level

expected_effects: monotonic growth of flooded road km, flooded camps and flooded buildings
loss of the lowest crossings first
assertions: flooded length, camps and buildings are non-decreasing across the sweep
no route through water deeper than the vehicle threshold
